title: Q-SAYDO-rules-CODE-ONLY-ORDER: says CODE-ONLY-ORDER, does not do it
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** say-do check (SAY-DO-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:CODE-ONLY-ORDER
**Status:** closed

The system states `CODE-ONLY-ORDER` (rules) and its code does not do it: python3 -m foundation standingorder --check: ledger decision-2026-11-26-disclose-1-the-full-specification-is-private-the-working-pro: decision recorded without a code consumer (probe must name an existing code or data file); make code consume it

Change the code to do what the statement says, or change the statement to what the code does; never weaken the probe.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:CODE-ONLY-ORDER` exits 0.

**Evidence:** say-do check at 2026-11-26T12:47:29Z: the statement matches its code or is no longer stated.
